---
description: "Use when preparing commits. Encourages clean history with task-based commits while allowing small cohesive changes in one commit."
name: "Commit Workflow"
---
# Commit Workflow

- Prefer splitting commits by task boundary (for example: config, implementation, docs) when work spans multiple scopes.
- For small cohesive changes, a single commit is acceptable.
- Keep commit messages explicit about the scope and outcome.
- Avoid mixing unrelated changes in one commit unless they are tightly coupled and cannot be reviewed separately.
